messages:
mari: Quick sync: SkyBridge integration + marketplace listing aiming for next month. Deliverables: marketplace tile, joint 40m webinar (10m value prop + 20m live demo + 10m Q&A), co-auth blog, and lead routing into our CRM. Who can own the routing map and the registration flows? :satellite:

samir: I can own routing (HubSpot) and SLA. Need to know what fields marketplace can pass back (email, name, utm). Also prefer a single reg page we control for best tracking.

tanya: Ill do webinar landing + two email streams (devs; platform). Drafts by Wed EOD. Will create form with audience radio that sets contact.segment.

kevin: Ill handle marketplace assets & copy. Need final 150-word blurb, 800x450 hero, and logo by Tue. Also confirm CTA URL.

mari: Recommendation: marketplace CTA -> our reg page with utm_source=skybridge_marketplace. If marketplace forces native capture, have it redirect with params. Samir, post workflow skeleton so we can sanity check.

samir: Workflow skeleton below (HubSpot style):

```json
{
  "workflow": "skybridge_partner_inbound",
  "trigger": ["utm_campaign == 'skybridge_launch'","source in ('marketplace','webinar')","form == 'skybridge_reg'"] ,
  "actions": ["set property: lead.partner = 'skybridge'","set property: lead.entry = marketplace|webinar","assign: partner-queue","notify: sales-oncall"]
}
```

samir: Ill add lead scoring rules (attendance bonus + demo request). Will publish screenshots by Thu.

tanya: For emails: three waves (announce, 2-day reminder, day-of). Two subject lines each for A/B. Planning social cards too.

kevin: Marketplace requires feature bullets and a short integration benefits section. Drafting now and will drop images into the design folder.

mari: Measurement: funnel metrics we care about = impressions -> clicks -> reg rate -> attend rate -> demo requests -> MQL. Jordan, can you make the dashboard? (cc Jordan in a follow-up).

ops-bot: Reminder: Webinar reserved for 2025-11-12 17:00 UTC. Calendar invites sent.

samir: Small question: do we tag leads created via marketplace as "partner_marketplace" for future partner revenue reporting? Suggest yes.

mari: Agree. Tag as partner_marketplace and partner_skybridge. Also ensure contact.custom.utm_full is stored so we can replay.

tanya: One UX callout: single reg page with audience selector reduces friction for marketplace CTA. Ill include hidden utm fields and a prefill flow.

kevin: Reaching out to SkyBridge PM for sandbox creds for demo provisioning. Will update thread when we have tokens.

samir: ETA: routing + docs ready by Mon COB. Ill add screenshots and the HubSpot naming conventions.

mari: Thanks all. Weekly check-in Fri 10am PT until launch. Keep blockers here. :thumbsup:
